subject: 世界书局福州路立面与外文书店店面
comparison_method: Each of 90 sampled areas from the original 2015 photograph reaches a pale facing material in its registered camera. Four individually measured aprons are also inspected normal to the facing surface, with a ray along each of 42 bed and 234 head joint centres and a second ray into an adjacent face. The complete inspected openings and results follow.
